# function: version_satisfies

Returns true when `version` meets `constraint`, using the same constraint syntax as `required_providers` and module `version` arguments (for example `>= 5.0, < 7.0` or `~> 6.2`). Use it in `check` block assertions with versions read from this provider's data sources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Warn when a new major version of a provider is out that your
# version constraint won't pick up.
check "aws_constraint_covers_latest" {
  data "registry_provider" "aws" {
    namespace = "hashicorp"
    name      = "aws"
  }

  assert {
    condition     = provider::registry::version_satisfies(data.registry_provider.aws.latest_version, "~> 6.0")
    error_message = "hashicorp/aws ${data.registry_provider.aws.latest_version} is out and \"~> 6.0\" won't pick it up."
  }
}

output "satisfied" {
  value = provider::registry::version_satisfies("6.2.0", ">= 6.0, < 7.0") # true
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
version_satisfies(version string, constraint string) bool
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `version` (String) Version to test, such as `6.2.0` or `v6.2.0`.
1. `constraint` (String) Version constraint, such as `~> 6.0`.
